prompt: Create an original 150 second cool jazz instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: muted trumpet, vibraphone, double bass, brushes. Style: spare melodic answers, extended chords and unhurried swing. Tempo approximately 78 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A smooth and melancholic jazz piece featuring a lead trumpet with a warm tone, accompanied by a gentle piano, walking bass, and brushed drums. The track evokes a relaxed and nostalgic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首流畅而忧郁的爵士乐曲，以音色温暖的小号为主奏，伴随着轻柔的钢琴、行走的低音提琴和刷奏的鼓点。这首曲子营造出一种放松而怀旧的氛围。
